_about: Written after the demo extractor was frozen and run once, unchanged, on 2026-11-16: 1 of 3 invoices read fully (and that one with the wrong vendor name, 10 of 11 fields); the other 2 went to review because the invoice number or date was not found. Nothing was approved wrongly. The misses (labels such as Tax Point / Your Order / Amount Owing, CA$, spaced VAT numbers, a header in parentheses, a table header without an amount column) were then fixed, so this set is no longer blind; it is kept as a regression set. All companies are made up. Tax ids are labelled without spaces. Dates are checked as of 2026-11-16.
